title: Erectile Dysfunction Protocol in Rats or Mice
author: Li-Ming Jin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yikfucw

steps.title: Anesthetize Animals
steps.instruction: Administer an intraperitoneal injection of 50 mg pentobarbital/kg weight to rats or mice.

steps.title: Perform Surgical Exposure
steps.instruction: Expose the penile and pelvic structures through a series of incisions and repositioning.

substeps.instruction: Make a midline incision from the umbilicus to the pubis.
Denude the penis of skin and circumcise the prepuce.
Divide the testes and epididymides from their scrotal attachments and reposition them into the abdomen.

steps.title: Place Electrodes and Pressure Transducer
steps.instruction: Install the hardware required for nerve stimulation and pressure measurement.

substeps.instruction: Attach bipolar silver wire electrodes unilaterally to the cavernous nerve arising from the ipsilateral pelvic plexus (situated dorsolateral to the prostate).
Insert a 25-gauge needle unilaterally at the base of the penis and connect it to a pressure transducer (Gould Polygraph, Cleveland, Ohio) to measure intracavernous pressures.

steps.title: Induce Penile Erection
steps.instruction: Apply electrical stimulation to the cavernous nerve using a Grass S48 square wave stimulator.

substeps.instruction: Set stimulator to 1-5 volts and 16 htz for 1 min.
Continue neurostimulation until a 10s maximal pressure recording is achieved, ensuring stimulation does not exceed 90s.
Allow at least 3 min to elapse between repeated stimulations.

steps.title: Analyze Erectile Function
steps.instruction: Calculate indices of erectile function based on pressure recordings.

substeps.instruction: Determine the Maximum intracavernosal pressure (Max ICP) and the total area under the ICP curve above baseline.
Normalize these values by the systemic mean arterial blood pressure (MAP).
